crew sop-patterns
models: capable=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free efficient=opencode-go/beam-free
roles (crew-declared): architect profile=Architect tier=capable
nodes:
  seed                     role=planner(Planner) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=plan ENTRY
  design                   role=architect(Architect) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=design watch=plan
                             ← rev-reviewer [verdict:lbtm] loop max_visits=2
                             ← solo_judge [verdict:revise] loop max_visits=2
                             ← seed [idle]
  human_review             role=reviewer(Reviewer) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=review
                             ← solo_judge [verdict:accept]
  solo_judge               role=judge(Judge) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=judgement
                             ← ap-critic-1 [idle]
                             ← ap-critic-2 [idle]
  builder                  role=engineer(Engineer) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=implementation
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← run-verify [verdict:fail] loop max_visits=2
  rev-reviewer             role=reviewer(Reviewer) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=review
                             ← design [idle]
  ap-critic-1              role=adversarial_reviewer(Adversary) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=critique
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← rev-reviewer [verdict:lgtm]
  ap-critic-2              role=adversarial_reviewer(Adversary) model=opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-free writes=critique
                             ← design [idle]
                             ← rev-reviewer [verdict:lgtm]
  run-verify               role=verifier(Verifier) model=opencode-go/beam-free writes=verification
                             ← builder [idle]
patterns:
  rev        reviewer_loop subject=design
  ap         adversarial_panel subject=design
  run        executor subject=design
checks:
  after builder              true
